Level 4 · Agentic AI

Level 4: Agentic AI Architecture

Design systems where AI agents do real work: tools, memory, limits, evaluation and human approval, documented so the next engineer can trust them.

See pathways

Planned: outline published, course not built

Who it is for
Architects and engineers who add agents to products or run agents inside their organisation.
Before you start
Level 3, Quality, Decisions and Evaluation, or equivalent experience designing systems against quality goals.
Capstone evidence
One agent system design: tools as contracts, memory, limits, evaluation plan and human approval.
How it is assessed
Planned: quiz questions, a design lab with checks, and a reviewed design. Not available yet.

Modules and evidence

Each module ends in an artefact that goes into your record.

ModuleWhat it coversEvidence
Agents as componentsWhat an agent is, architecturally.A workflow-or-agent decision with reasons, tool contracts and an autonomy level
Designing agent systemsPatterns, limits and failure.Orchestration, approval and failure design with budgets
Making them trustworthyEvidence, visibility and safety.Evaluation plan, tracing design, an agent security boundary and an agent architecture document
